parameters.content: ## 🤖 Wariskan — WhatsApp AI Bookkeeper | Base Workflow**Builder 3 (PM/Infra):** Setup credentials (Supabase Postgres, Anthropic, OpenAI, WhatsApp) + env vars + aktifkan webhook di Meta Developer Console.**Builder 1:** Implement node **Claude Extract** — paste system prompt dari `prompts/extraction-system-prompt.md`, parse JSON response, connect ke Validate JSON.**Builder 2:** Implement **Whisper STT** + **Claude Vision** — handle download audio/image dari WA Media API, kirim ke OpenAI/Anthropic, connect ke Validate JSON.🟡 Kuning = Parsing & User | 🟣 Ungu = Routing | 🔴 Merah = AI (Builder 1 & 2) | 🟢 Hijau = Storage & Reply | 🔵 Biru = Verification

## ✅ Meta Webhook Verification (GET)Meta kirim GET ke URL webhook saat pertama kali dikonfigurasi.Workflow ini cek `hub.verify_token` dan balas dengan `hub.challenge`.**Env var yang dibutuhkan:**`WHATSAPP_VERIFY_TOKEN` = token yang kamu set di Meta Developer Console**Setup:** Webhook → Meta App → WhatsApp → Configuration → Callback URL

## 📨 Message Ingestion & User Management1. **Parse Payload** → ekstrak sender, messageId, type, content2. **Get or Create User** → lookup by phone di Supabase, buat baru jika belum ada3. **Log Incoming Message** → simpan raw payload (idempotent via wamid UNIQUE)⚠️ `rawPayload` disimpan untuk debugging.Jangan hapus `incoming_messages` records saat testing.**Env vars:** `SUPABASE_URL`, `SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY`

## 🤖 AI Processing — IMPLEMENT HERE (Builder 1 & 2)**Claude Extract (text/audio):** POST → Anthropic API- Paste system prompt dari `prompts/extraction-system-prompt.md`- Parse `$json.content[0].text` sebagai JSON- Env: `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`**Whisper STT (audio):** POST → OpenAI `/v1/audio/transcriptions`- Kirim audio blob dari Download Media, terima transcript- Env: `OPENAI_API_KEY`**Claude Vision (image):** POST → Anthropic API dengan image_url- Model: claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022

## 💾 Storage & WhatsApp Reply1. **Validate JSON** → cek output Claude punya field wajib (category, nominal)2. **Save to Supabase** → POST `/rest/v1/transactions`3. **Save to Google Sheets** → call `appendTransaction()` via HTTP ke helper4. **Send WhatsApp Reply** → kirim konfirmasi ke user**Env vars:** `SUPABASE_URL`, `SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY`, `WHATSAPP_TOKEN`, `WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID`💡 Builder 1: connect Validate JSON → Save Supabase setelah Claude Extract ready

const items = $input.all();
if (items[0].json._skip) return items;

const userMessage = items[0].json.promptInput || items[0].json.transcript || items[0].json.text || '';

const SYSTEM_PROMPT = [
  'Kamu adalah AI pencatat keuangan warung/toko kecil Indonesia.',
  'Tugasmu: ekstrak SATU transaksi dari pesan WhatsApp user (bahasa Indonesia / daerah).',
  '',
  '## ATURAN OUTPUT',
  'Kembalikan HANYA JSON valid. Tidak boleh ada teks lain sebelum/sesudah JSON.',
  'Format: {"category":"...","nominal":0,"item":null,"pihak":null,"tanggal":null,"jatuh_tempo":null,"confidence":"high"}',
  '',
  '## KATEGORI (pilih salah satu)',
  '- pemasukan: jualan, terima uang, setoran, omset, pendapatan, dapat bayaran',
  '- pengeluaran: beli barang/makanan/bensin/pulsa, bayar listrik/air/sewa, ongkos, modal, belanja, kasbon',
  '- hutang: pinjam uang DARI orang lain, ngutang, minjem duit (user YANG berhutang)',
  '- piutang: orang lain pinjam uang KE user, ngasih pinjaman, minjemin duit (user YANG memberi pinjaman)',
  '- bayar_hutang: user melunasi/mencicil hutang ke orang lain',
  '- terima_piutang: user menerima pembayaran dari orang yang pernah pinjam',
  '- unclear: tidak bisa ditentukan atau bukan transaksi keuangan',
  '',
  '## KONVERSI NOMINAL (selalu output angka penuh)',
  '- 50rb / 50ribu / 50 rb = 50000',
  '- 1jt / 1juta = 1000000',
  '- 1,5jt / 1.5jt = 1500000',
  '- 500perak / 500p = abaikan (terlalu kecil, bukan transaksi)',
  '- Jika tidak disebut nominal, isi 0 dan confidence=low',
  '',
  '## DETEKSI KONTEKS IMPLISIT',
  '- "jual ayam 50" tanpa unit = asumsikan ribuan (50000)',
  '- "beli gula 25" tanpa unit = asumsikan ribuan (25000)',
  '- "dapet 200" = asumsikan ribuan jika <= 999 (200000), jutaan jika >= 1000 (2000000)',
  '- "warung sepi, cuma 50" = pemasukan 50000',
  '- "hari ini 150" = pemasukan 150000',
  '- "modal 100" = pengeluaran 100000',
  '- "ngutang dulu 50, besok ganti" = hutang 50000',
  '',
  '## CONTOH LENGKAP',
  'jual ayam 50rb -> {"category":"pemasukan","nominal":50000,"item":"ayam","pihak":null,"tanggal":null,"jatuh_tempo":null,"confidence":"high"}',
  'beli gula 25rb di warung -> {"category":"pengeluaran","nominal":25000,"item":"gula","pihak":"warung","tanggal":null,"jatuh_tempo":null,"confidence":"high"}',
  'si Budi minjem 100rb -> {"category":"piutang","nominal":100000,"item":null,"pihak":"Budi","tanggal":null,"jatuh_tempo":null,"confidence":"high"}',
  'minjem duit Bu RT 50rb -> {"category":"hutang","nominal":50000,"item":"modal","pihak":"Bu RT","tanggal":null,"jatuh_tempo":null,"confidence":"high"}',
  'bayar utang ke Bang Udin 200rb -> {"category":"bayar_hutang","nominal":200000,"item":null,"pihak":"Bang Udin","tanggal":null,"jatuh_tempo":null,"confidence":"high"}',
  'si Ani udah bayar utangnya 500rb -> {"category":"terima_piutang","nominal":500000,"item":null,"pihak":"Ani","tanggal":null,"jatuh_tempo":null,"confidence":"high"}',
  'warung sepi cuma dapet 50 -> {"category":"pemasukan","nominal":50000,"item":null,"pihak":null,"tanggal":null,"jatuh_tempo":null,"confidence":"medium"}',
  'beli bensin 100 -> {"category":"pengeluaran","nominal":100000,"item":"bensin","pihak":null,"tanggal":null,"jatuh_tempo":null,"confidence":"high"}',
  'halo -> {"category":"unclear","nominal":0,"item":null,"pihak":null,"tanggal":null,"jatuh_tempo":null,"confidence":"low"}'
].join('\n');

try {
  const response = await this.helpers.httpRequest({
    method: 'POST',
    url: 'https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages',
    headers: {
      'x-api-key': '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',
      'anthropic-version': '2023-06-01',
      'content-type': 'application/json'
    },
    body: {
      model: 'claude-3-haiku-20240307',
      max_tokens: 512,
      system: SYSTEM_PROMPT,
      messages: [{ role: 'user', content: userMessage }]
    },
    json: true,
    returnFullResponse: true,
    ignoreHttpStatusErrors: true
  });

  items[0].json.message = response.body || response;
} catch (error) {
  items[0].json.message = {
    content: [{ type: 'text', text: '{}' }]
  };
  console.log('[Claude Extract] API call failed:', error.message);
}

return items;
